status: proposal tested with simulated consumer; not agreed with real Antsand; no deployed evaluation service

implemented_boundary.native_head_component_evidence: Existing generated complete-head tests use supplied backbone features; separate from this fixture-replay contract test.

input.artifact_id: registered feature artifact, not a path or text

request.candidate_ids: ordered unique registered IDs; no labels or executable actions

policy.minimum_logit_margin: finite 0..100; explicit consumer policy, not calibrated confidence

request.identity: 1-64 ASCII letters/digits/dot/underscore/hyphen; boot identities are 32 lowercase hex digits
request.encoding: UTF-8 JSON; duplicate keys, unknown request fields and NaN/Infinity rejected

score_semantics: raw logits in request candidate order; no softmax or calibrated confidence is returned
decision_semantics: Exact top ties abstain; otherwise abstain if top-minus-second logit is below requested margin. Single candidate ranks trivially. Selection is informational, executed is always false.
identity_semantics: Echo expected adapter/worker/model identities and canonical request hash. A restart rejects old boot IDs with RESTARTED. Clients must refresh approved discovery before another attempt; no automatic identity acceptance.
evidence: Input hash, model revision, nullable tokenizer revision, registered evidence/IR IDs, nullable native-library SHA-256 and separately scoped numerical parity. Simulation must say contract_simulation + fixture_replay + NOT_TESTED, with no native library. Artifact retrieval requires separate authorization; responses contain no host paths.
deadline_semantics: timeout_ms bounds the consumer attempt; socket shutdown enforces a total transport deadline, and one absolute monotonic deadline is rechecked inside the publication lock immediately before making a result current. Validation and lock wait consume the same budget; equality with the deadline is expired. Simulated worker checks deadline before publication. No native interruption guarantee exists yet.
cancellation_semantics: Consumer cancellation/replacement invalidates pending replies immediately. There is no worker cancel endpoint; already-admitted simulation finishes and releases its slot. Native compute cancellation is NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
concurrency_semantics: Test responder admits one evaluation, rejects concurrent admission BUSY with HTTP 429, and has no evaluation queue. This is not production connection-limit certification.
privacy_authorization: No request bodies or prompts in routine logs. Antsand owns user/group authorization; neither score nor candidate selection grants access. Only synthetic fixture data is used. No training, model download, arbitrary commands or business actions.
connection_scope: Consumer accepts only literal loopback HTTP /evaluate. Real remote exposure and approved adapter execution require a separate authenticated contract; this PR does not deploy or alter running services.
malformed_request_errors: Structured JSON with recoverable request_id, otherwise null; model/request hash null because no valid request was accepted. Clients must not treat these as evaluation results.
